_comment: Per-pixel intensity, drawn by emtk. The settings window on the left (file, detector window, the actions), the maps as tabs on the right. The Qt tool's AutoForm spec is intensity.view.json.

sections.title: Settings
sections.description: The source file, the detector window that is shown and the actions that compute and write the maps.
Compute the maps, write them out, explore them or go on to the next step.

buttons.label: Run
buttons.description: Compute the per-pixel photon counts and count rates of every detector window, in the background. Nothing is recomputed when neither the file nor the detector windows changed.

buttons.label: Create imaging HDF5
buttons.description: Write the per-pixel table (counts, count rates, number of photons, the back-reference to the photon file) to the imaging HDF5 the next analysis steps enrich. With a file already remembered by the pipeline it is written there; otherwise a file is asked for.

buttons.label: Save container
buttons.description: Write the same table as a pixel-map artifact into the container beside the photon file (the Qt tool did this when it closed).

buttons.label: ndX
buttons.description: Explore the per-pixel table in ndX, the shared live dataset. A Back button returns to the maps.

buttons.label: Next
buttons.description: Remember the file and the HDF5 and go to the next analysis step. Only available inside the Imaging Tools pipeline.

sections.label: TTTR file
sections.placeholder: pick a file, drop one here, or load from the database
sections.description: PTU/HT3 imaging file with line and frame markers (or drop one onto the window: it is loaded and run). The scanner geometry is read from its header. Press Enter to select a typed path.
Pick the photon file from disk or from the database.

buttons.label: Browse
buttons.description: Browse for a photon imaging file on disk.

buttons.label: Database
buttons.description: Load a dataset registered in the database; the database resolves it to a local file wherever its object store keeps the data.

sections.label: Detector window
sections.description: The detector window shown in the maps. Every window is computed and written; this only chooses which one is displayed. The windows come from the Detectors tab (or the Imaging Tools setup step); without any, the channel-0 window is used.
What was computed: the file, the size of the image and the detector windows.

sections.title: Intensity
sections.description: The summed photon counts per pixel of the displayed detector window.

sections.title: Intensity
sections.description: Photon counts per pixel, summed over all frames. Wheel zooms, drag pans; the colormap, gamma and levels change the display only.

options.name: Intensity
options.empty: No intensity yet. Select a photon file and press Run.

sections.title: Count rate (kHz)
sections.description: The count rate per pixel: photons divided by the pixel dwell, with the detector background subtracted.

sections.title: Count rate (kHz)
sections.description: Count rate in kHz: total photons divided by the scanner dwell time of the pixel, minus the calibrated background of the detector, never below zero.

options.name: Count rate
options.empty: No count rate yet. Select a photon file and press Run.

sections.title: Frames (movie)
sections.description: The raw per-frame intensity stack of the displayed detector window.

sections.title: Frames (movie)
sections.description: The scanner frames one after the other: play, loop, stop and the playback speed. This is a time series, not an axial stack.

options.name: Frames
options.empty: No frames yet. Select a photon file and press Run.
